articles.summary: BEIJING, March 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Autohome Inc. (NYSE: ATHM; HKEX: 2518) (" Autohome " or the "Company"), the leading online destination for automobile consumers in China, today announced its unaudited financial results for the three months and full year ended December 31, 2025.
articles.title: Autohome Inc. Announces Unaudited Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results and US$200 Million Share Repurchase Program
